manual: Rust via rustup (install.sh installs toolchain 1.97 from rust-toolchain.toml). Debian rustc 1.85 is older than upstream's rust-version.
install.sh also adds the x86_64 and aarch64 musl targets. make install embeds those static disktree-scan helpers for SSH scans.
A Vulkan GPU is required. GPUI opens an X11 window when WAYLAND_DISPLAY is unset.
Theme colours come from ~/.local/state/omarchy/current/theme/colors.toml via gpui-omarchy.
Optional float rule: install.sh copies omaxian/i3-disktree.conf to ~/.config/i3/config.d/ when that file is missing. Reload with i3-msg reload.
